subject: Mutual Action Plan & Next Steps — Acme MAP Recap
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Turner <jamie.turner@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan & Next Steps — Acme MAP Recap

Hi Jamie —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned on pain, scope, and the proposed mutual action plan (MAP). I’ve attached a draft MAP and a short scope doc.

Key pain points / goals you shared:
- Slow inference latency on retrieval-augmented workflows (peak 400ms p50 -> target <150ms)
- Growing token costs for embeddings and generation with current vendor
- Need predictable pricing and private deployment option for regulated PII workflows

Success metrics / pilot goals:
- Pilot Q4: 1 production route at 99% of current feature parity, p50 latency <200ms
- Cost comparison: target 30% unit-cost improvement vs current baseline
- Security: SOC 2 + VPC/on-prem evaluation for regulated data flows

Proposed MAP (high level):
1) Week of Aug 9 — Technical kickoff (Redwood eng + Acme infra) — stakeholders: Marissa, Dev (Redwood); Lisa (Acme VP Eng)
2) Aug 16–30 — POC: integration + baseline perf tests (Dev to provide infra checklist)
3) Sep 6 — Initial results & pricing review (Redwood to provide unit-cost model)
4) Sep 20 — Security & procurement packet sent (SOC2 snapshot, IP & SLA terms)
5) Oct 4 — Pilot go/no-go decision (Acme execs)

Next steps I’ll take this week:
- Attach updated MAP draft and scope (attached)
- Share SOC2 snapshot link and procurement checklist
- Book technical kickoff — propose Aug 10 or Aug 11, 10:00–11:00 PT

Can you confirm:
- Core stakeholders (who should be on the kickoff)
- Target pilot start window (early Oct vs mid-Oct)

Attachments:
- 20270730-acme-map-draft.xlsx (MAP milestones, owners, dates)
- acme-scope-of-work-v1.pdf (scope & success criteria)

Thanks — speak soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Thanks for the clear summary. This aligns with our conversation. A few clarifications from our side:

Stakeholders to include:
- Lisa Nguyen (VP Engineering) — technical decision-maker
- Mark Ellis (Procurement) — will lead contracting and POC terms
- Jamie Turner (Product Lead) — success criteria owner

Timeline notes:
- We are aiming for a Q4 pilot but would prefer pilot kickoff the week of Oct 4 if possible (to align with scheduling). If you can make the earlier milestone dates support that, great.

Requests / asks:
- Can you share a SOC 2 snapshot and any data handling documentation?
- High-level pricing bands for pilot (monthly committed vs pay-as-you-go) + any estimates for the pilot scope you outlined
- Procurement checklist or standard MSA we can hand to procurement

I’m available for the technical kickoff Aug 10 (10:00 PT) — Lisa will join if we confirm. Mark may join the kickoff or be looped in on the procurement-specific calls.

Thanks — attaching our procurement template for reference.

-Jamie

Jamie — great, thanks for the quick reply and for sharing the procurement template.

I attached the SOC 2 snapshot and a short procurement checklist for Mark. Pricing note (high level):
- Pilot (one production route + eval): estimated $6k–$9k/month depending on batching & quantization profile; committed monthly pricing available — we’ll scope exact tokens after the POC run
- Committed pricing (post-pilot) can be discussed once we baseline throughput and model choice

SOC2 & procurement docs attached:
- SOC2-snapshot.pdf
- Redwood-procurement-checklist.pdf (short checklist for Mark)

Technical kickoff confirmed: Aug 10, 10:00 PT — I’ll send a calendar invite and agenda.

Dev/Michael — please see Jamie/Lisa’s notes above. Action items for Redwood:
- Dev: bring integration checklist and required infra (service account, VPC peering options)
- Michael: prepare a short cost model for the pilot and a pricing band to share on Sep 6

Jamie — I’ll follow up with the calendar invite and a link to the MAP in Drive.

Best,
Marissa

Quick internal notes — looping in some specifics to bring to the Aug 10 kickoff:

Integration checklist (high level):
- Service account creation & scoped API key for POC
- VPC peering options (we’ll supply VPC endpoint + routing guidance)
- Expected traffic profile: ~10–20 concurrent inference streams during load tests; avg seq length 512 tokens
- KV cache requirements for RAG: recommend enabling prefix caching, size TBD after initial run

Questions for Michael to finalize cost model:
- Which quantization profile do we propose for initial POC (int8 vs int4)?
- Batching assumptions: target p50 latency <200ms — need to estimate throughput vs cost trade-offs

I’ll prepare the technical annex and bring a short demo of our telemetry dashboard showing latency breakdowns.

Thanks — Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwoodinference.com
thread_summary: Post-call recap confirming Acme pain points (latency, cost, security), proposed MAP with milestones and owners, SOC2 and procurement docs shared, technical kickoff set for Aug 10, action items assigned to Dev (integration) and Michael (pricing).
